# Valrico Real Estate — Barrett Henry

## About
Barrett Henry is a licensed Florida Broker Associate with REMAX Collective. With 23+ years of real estate experience, Barrett specializes in Valrico's neighborhoods including Bloomingdale, Buckhorn, River Hills, and 30+ other communities.
